description:
The fleet console as a served surface: a read-only observability peer
    presenting membership, discovery, and space state over HTTP. A HAL+JSON
    API (application/hal+json links, Spring HATEOAS compatible), a
    Server-Sent Events activity stream, a single-file no-build web UI themed
    by CSS variables, and the ConsolePanel SPI so applications add their own
    panels. Served by the JDK HttpServer like the A2A gateway, so the core
    carries no web framework; the Spring Boot starter wires it from
    properties.
